2024-01-29
Claim opened after a side impact at a signalized intersection, with the insured vehicle strcuk on the driver side by a
vehicle entering from the cross street. The claimant reports neck pain and has retained counsel, who has asked that
all contact go through their office.
2024-02-13
Reviewed the policy and confirmed the driver is named on it and that coverage was active at the time of loss. Nothing
in the file suggests the damage predates the policy start.
2024-02-16
Obtained the statements of the other driver and two independent witnesses, all of whom describe the collision the
same way. Scene photos are consistent with that account.
2024-03-06
Inspected the vehicle. The damage is mostly in line with the described impact, concentrated on the driver-side door
and quarter panel, and no prior damage to the vehicle is known from our records or the repair history.
2024-03-28
Medical records show a whiplash diagnosis, which is a plausible injury for a crash of this type. No earlier injury to the
same area is known from the records obtained so far.
2024-04-07
Treatment followed a usual course, with physical therapy and medication, and the claimant's symptoms tapered as
they improved. Follow-up visits have become less frequent.
2024-06-15
In a recorded interview the claimant added some small details about the sequence of events, but the core account
has not changed. It is still unclear from the statements where in the vehicle the claimant was seated at impact, and I
have asked counsel to clarify.
2024-06-29
Based on the evidence reviewed so far, the claim is consistent with the reported loss and injury. Continuing to monitor
the treatment record and will request a final medical summary before setting a settlement range.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
